motion.name: spring-bounce
motion.purpose: Playful spring physics on hover and active states for buttons and cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Used for main actions like Sign In or Submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6750A4; color: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; transition: all 500ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Tonal Tag
components.description: Used to filter or categorize by Raag.
components.css: .ds-tag { background: rgba(125, 82, 96, 0.1); color: #7D5260; padding: 6px 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; transition: all 200ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tag:hover { background: rgba(125, 82, 96, 0.2); transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-tag:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

narrative.overview: The system is focused on preservation and easy retrieval, but it is not a dusty ledger. It is tactile and responsive, built around a vibrant Material 3 color palette. Elements spring to life with playful scaling and transitions to invite interaction, making practice and discovery feel dynamic.
keyCharacteristics: Extreme roundness on interactive elements and containers.
Playful spring physics on hover and active states.
Tonal backgrounds and borders instead of drop shadows at rest.

rules.name: The Tonal Border Rule
rules.body: Instead of gray borders, all borders derive from the surface-high token of the current active theme, ensuring they blend harmoniously with the background.

rules.name: The Generous Line-Height Rule
rules.body: Lyrics and notation require breathing room. Always use relaxed leading to prevent dense blocks of text.

rules.name: The Physical Lift Rule
rules.body: We do not use drop shadows. Elevation is communicated entirely through scale and translation.

dos: Do use cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) for all interactive scaling transitions.
Do use tonal backgrounds (e.g., bg-m3-primary/10) for subtle emphasis instead of gray boxes.
donts: Don't use box-shadow to elevate cards. Rely on the hover scale and translate effect.
Don't use sharp corners (rounded-sm or rounded-none). The system requires soft geometry.
